tagline: Fault-tolerant self-healing runtime systems for mission-critical robotics and autonomous edge computing.

bullets: Edge robotics face unpredictable software crashes, loops, and telemetry corruption mid-mission.
A single software lockup causes physical loss of drone units or multi-million dollar logistics line standstills.
Current watchdogs perform cold reboots, introducing dangerous multi-second recovery windows.
Kryptic-Agent intercepts structural state errors in memory via microsecond homeostatic validation nodes.
Raw zero-buffering flash loggers preserve entire state machine operations safely through violent power loss.
Zero-latency design loops introduce under 1ms overhead, making it highly optimal for embedded systems.
Primary Target: High-value defense tactical UAV manufacturing partnerships.
Secondary Target: Autonomous industrial robotics operating inside critical infrastructure.
Revenue Framework: Scalable per-device monthly SaaS fees matched against dedicated custom engineering implementation agreements.
